g.text: Static cost of a close-front observation and return
3 development + 6 predesigned test layouts | Four devices remain in every task denominator
Paid actions: graph travel + one observation + full-pose return. Extra inspection is excluded.
Orange outlines: cost exceeds 120 actions for that single close-front visit; this is not a task-failure label.
Conditional minima within certified close-front coarse poses, not global continuous optima or measured policy cost.
